issue.title: Bug: [crm] test_crm_neighbor misses THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED because swss rsyslog rate-limits orchagent

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

It shows up on platforms with large neighbor tables. Seen on a Broadcom DNX (Q3D) platform, NH-5010-F, `t2-single-node-min` topology.

### Importance or Severity

Medium. `test_crm_neighbor` fails on every run on the affected platform.

### Description of the bug

`tests/crm/test_crm.py::test_crm_neighbor` (IPv4 and IPv6) fails at the first threshold step (`exceeded_used`):

```
LogAnalyzerError: match: 0
expected_match: 0
expected_missing_match: 1

Expected Messages that are missing:
.* THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED .*
```

orchagent does compute the threshold crossing: CRM `used` equals the configured high value. But the warning never reaches syslog because the swss container's rsyslog is rate-limiting orchagent.

To reach 1% of the neighbor resource, the test bulk-adds neighbors, and orchagent logs two NOTICE lines per neighbor (`addNeighbor` and `addNextHop`). On a platform with about 3.2M IPv4 neighbor entries available, 1% is about 32k neighbors, or about 65k log lines. The swss imuxsock limit is 20000 messages per 300 seconds. Once it trips, rsyslog drops every orchagent message for the rest of the interval, including `THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED` and `THRESHOLD_CLEAR`:

```
INFO swss#rsyslogd: imuxsock[pid: 187, name: /usr/bin/orchagent] from <dut:orchagent>: begin to drop messages due to rate-limiting
INFO swss#rsyslogd: imuxsock[pid: 187, name: /usr/bin/orchagent]: 38363 messages lost due to rate-limiting (20000 allowed within 300 seconds)
```

In the same runs, CRM threshold messages that fall outside the drop window (route, nexthop, ACL) are logged normally. The 300-second window carries over into the following test cases, so depending on timing `test_crm_nexthop_group` fails the same way.

#27176 added `disable_swss_syslog_rate_limit()` for `test_crm_nexthop_group`, but `test_crm_neighbor` and `test_crm_nexthop` bulk-add neighbors the same way and don't use it. #27176 is also not on 202511 yet.

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Run `tests/crm/test_crm.py -k "test_crm_neighbor"` on a platform whose IPv4/IPv6 neighbor `available` count is large enough that 1% needs more than ~10k neighbors.
2. Check syslog for the swss `imuxsock ... begin to drop messages due to rate-limiting` line during the neighbor bulk add.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Actual: `THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED` for the `IPV4_NEIGHBOR` / `IPV6_NEIGHBOR` resource is dropped by rsyslog, and the test fails.

Expected: the test disables swss syslog rate limiting while it verifies thresholds, as it already does for nexthop group, and passes.

### Relevant log output

See above.

### Output of `show version`

```
SONiC Software Version: SONiC.202511
Platform: x86_64-nexthop_5010-r0
HwSKU: NH-5010-F-O64
ASIC: broadcom (broadcom-dnx)
```

resolution.title: [crm] Disable SWSS syslog rate limiting for neighbor and nexthop threshold checks
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary:
Fixes #28105

`test_crm_neighbor` and `test_crm_nexthop` bulk-add neighbors until they reach 1% of the resource, then check for the CRM threshold warnings. orchagent logs two NOTICE lines per neighbor (`addNeighbor` and `addNextHop`). On platforms with large neighbor tables, the burst exceeds the swss rsyslog imuxsock limit (20000 messages per 300 seconds). rsyslog then drops every orchagent message for the rest of the interval, including `THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED` and `THRESHOLD_CLEAR`, and the test fails:

```
Expected Messages that are missing:
.* THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED .*
```

The CRM counters themselves are correct (`used` equals the high threshold). The message is dropped by rsyslog:

```
INFO swss#rsyslogd: imuxsock[pid: 187, name: /usr/bin/orchagent] from <dut:orchagent>: begin to drop messages due to rate-limiting
INFO swss#rsyslogd: imuxsock[pid: 187, name: /usr/bin/orchagent]: 38363 messages lost due to rate-limiting (20000 allowed within 300 seconds)
```

#27176 added `disable_swss_syslog_rate_limit()` and applied it to `test_crm_nexthop_group`. This PR applies the same helper to the neighbor and nexthop threshold checks. No new code; two `verify_thresholds()` calls are wrapped in the existing context manager.

The failure is not branch specific. On the affected platform it failed on every run over the last four weeks with master, 202605 and 202511 images.

### Type of change

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [ ] New Test case
    - [ ] Skipped for non-supported platforms
- [ ] Test case improvement

### Back port request
- [ ] 202311
- [ ] 202405
- [ ] 202411
- [ ] 202505
- [ ] 202511
- [ ] 202512
- [x] 202605

Tracking issue/work item for backport/cherry-pick request (GitHub issue or Microsoft ADO): #28105
Failure type: day-one issue on platforms with large neighbor tables

Backport notes:
- **202605:** needs #27176 as well, since it provides the helper and isn't on 202605 yet. Both cherry-pick cleanly onto 202605 in order (#27176, then this PR).
- **202511:** handled by the manual backport #28131. #27176 conflicts on 202511, and its helper needs a small adaptation there because 202511 images use the legacy `$SystemLogRateLimitInterval` rsyslog directive.

### Tested branch
- [ ] master
- [ ] 202311
- [ ] 202405
- [ ] 202411
- [ ] 202505
- [x] 202511
- [ ] 202512
- [x] 202605
- [ ] N/A

### Test result

- 202511: `SONiC.202511.1222892-28ce9b5ec`, NH-5010-F (`x86_64-nexthop_5010-r0`, Broadcom DNX), `t2-single-node-max` topology, tested through the backport #28131 (this change plus #27176 and the 202511 helper adaptation). `crm/test_crm.py` 10 passed, 1 skipped (`test_crm_fdb_entry`, T0/M0-only topology). `test_crm_neighbor[4|6]` and `test_crm_nexthop[4|6]` pass. Before the change, `test_crm_neighbor[4|6]` failed on every run with the missing `THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED` shown above.
- 202605: community image `202605.1225487-b89b15fda` (sonic-net/sonic-buildimage 202605), NH-5010-F (`x86_64-nexthop_5010-r0`, Broadcom DNX), `t2-single-node-max` topology. sonic-mgmt `202605` at `f2f514edcf` plus #27176 and #28106.
  - Before: `test_crm_neighbor[4|6]` and `test_crm_nexthop_group[False]` fail with `Expected Messages that are missing: .* THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED .*`.
  - After: all CRM threshold cases pass:
    ```
    PASSED test_crm_route[ipv4]              PASSED test_crm_route[ipv6]
    PASSED test_crm_nexthop[4]               PASSED test_crm_nexthop[6]
    PASSED test_crm_neighbor[4]              PASSED test_crm_neighbor[6]
    PASSED test_crm_nexthop_group[False]     PASSED test_crm_nexthop_group[True]
    ```
    `test_acl_entry` fails in the same run. It is an ACL CRM counter check that also fails on the unmodified 202605 image and is unrelated to this change.
- master: the same `test_crm_neighbor` failure is seen on every run on the same platform; not yet run on hardware with this change.

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Details are in #28105. On a platform with about 3.2M IPv4 neighbor entries available, reaching 1% needs about 32k neighbors, or about 65k orchagent log lines, which is far above the 20000 per 300 s imuxsock limit.

#### How did you do it?
Wrapped `verify_thresholds()` in `test_crm_neighbor` and `test_crm_nexthop` with `disable_swss_syslog_rate_limit()`. The helper sets the swss imuxsock rate-limit interval to 0 and restarts rsyslogd, which also clears any drop window already in progress. It restores the original configuration on exit.

`test_crm_nexthop` passes today on this platform only because it adds fewer entries. It uses the same bulk-add pattern, so it's covered as well.

#### How did you verify/test it?
Ran the full `crm/test_crm.py` on hardware with 202511 and 202605 images (see Test result).

#### Any platform specific information?
The code isn't platform specific. It matters on platforms with large neighbor tables.

#### Supported testbed topology if it's a new test case?
N/A

### Documentation
N/A
